42.desc:
Pineapple Donut is a sativa of Franken Cakes × Gorilla Diesel—Wedding Cake–style pastry and GMO/Lava Cake funk on one side, GG4 × Sour Diesel gas on the other. The jar smells like a box of glazed pineapple donuts: sweet dough, brown sugar, and juicy tropical fruit, with citrus zest and a light diesel kick on the exhale. The high hits fast—buzzy, happy, talkative energy that stays social and creative instead of racy, with only a light body ease so you can still move. It’s for daytime dessert chasers, pineapple fans who want pastry not just juice, and anyone shopping sativa flower that tastes like breakfast and actually gets you off the couch.

Why You’ll Love It:
Whole Flower: Packed with fresh, whole flower—never trim or shake.
Glazed Pineapple Donut with Diesel Zest: Sweet dough, brown sugar, and juicy pineapple up front, then citrus peel and a light Gorilla Diesel kick; bakery first, fuel on the finish.
Fast, happy daytime spark: A buzzy, talkative head opens the session; the body stays light so it stays social and usable, built for morning and afternoon, not the couch.

43.desc: Ouzo 7 is a Gelato × Gelato GMO Sativa that stacks Sunset Sherbet × Thin Mint GSC cream on a GMO (Chem D × GSC) cut, then leans into the anise-and-citrus nose the name promises. The jar smells like black licorice and fennel over sweet gelato, lemon zest, and pine, with a peppery GMO-gas finish instead of straight garlic funk. The high usually opens bright and talkative—happy, a little focused—then eases into a calm body melt that stays functional longer than a heavy GMO nightcap. It’s for flavor hunters who want dessert without candy-only terps, Gelato fans who like a herbal twist, and anyone shopping a balanced evening Sativa that still feels social before it settles.
